acid.x: Add a claw to your roll every turn, even when you roll none.

cosmic.x: Power cards cost you 1 energy less.

alpha.x: Gain 1 star on every turn you roll at least one claw.

plated.x: You lose no hearts when you would lose exactly 1 heart.

lurker.x: You can always reroll any of your 3s, even after your last roll.

tunnel.x: Add a claw to your roll while you are in the city. When you yield the city, the monster taking your place loses 1 heart.

chameleon.x: When you lose hearts, roll a die for each one. Every heart rolled saves 1 of them.

spree.x: If your dice show 1, 2, 3, heart, claw and energy, gain 9 stars as well.

news.x: Gain 1 star whenever you buy a power card.

carrion.x: Gain 3 stars every time a monster drops to 0 hearts.

battery.x: At the end of your turn, gain 1 star for every 6 energy you hold.

growth.x: Heal 2 when you buy this. Your maximum hearts go up by 2.

scorch.x: When you roll at least one claw, the monsters seated next to you lose 1 extra heart.

hiccup.x: On a turn you roll three or more 1s, take another turn afterwards with one die fewer (one fewer again each time it repeats).

kidfan.x: Whenever you gain energy, gain 1 more.

brain.x: You get one extra reroll each turn.

gourmand.x: When you roll three or more 1s, gain 2 extra stars.

healray.x: You may spend your heart dice to heal other monsters. Each pays you 2 energy per heart it gains (1 if that is its last energy).

grazer.x: Gain 1 star at the end of your turn if you made nobody lose hearts.

pack.x: Once per turn, turn one of your dice into a 1.

egg.x: If you are knocked out, discard all your cards, lose all your stars, leave the city and hatch again with 10 hearts.

vjets.x: You lose no hearts when you choose to yield the city.

lab.x: In your buy step you may peek at the top card of the deck, then buy it or put it back.

meta.x: At the end of your turn you may discard any of your Keep cards to gain their full cost in energy.

mimic.x: Pick a Keep card any monster has: this card copies it. At the start of your turn you may pay 1 energy to copy a different one.

cell.x: When you buy this, put 6 energy from the bank on it. At the start of your turn move 2 of them to your pool. Discard it when it is empty.

nova.x: Your claws hit every other monster, wherever they are.

omni.x: When you roll at least one 1, one 2 and one 3, gain 2 stars. Those dice still count for other sets.

opp.x: Whenever a new power card is turned face up, you may buy it at once, before anyone else.

para.x: You may buy Keep cards from other monsters, paying the owner their cost.

twist.x: Before resolving, you may turn one die to any face. Then discard this card.

quills.x: When you roll three or more 2s, add two claws to your roll.

pspit.x: Each monster your claws hit gets a poison token. A monster loses 1 heart per poison token at the end of its turn. A heart die can remove one token instead of healing.

probe.x: After each other monster’s last roll you may reroll one of its dice. If it comes up a heart, discard this card.

mend.x: At any time, pay 2 energy to heal 1 heart, even to avoid being knocked out.

regrow.x: Whenever you gain hearts, gain 1 extra.

underdog.x: At the end of your turn, if you have the fewest stars, gain 1 star.

shrink.x: Each monster your claws hit gets a shrink token. A monster rolls 1 die fewer per shrink token. A heart die can remove one token instead of healing.

smoke.x: Comes with 3 puffs. Spend a puff for an extra reroll. Discard it when they are gone.

sun.x: At the end of your turn, if you have no energy, gain 1.

barbed.x: When you roll at least one claw, add another claw to your roll.

rubber.x: Before resolving, you may pay 2 energy to turn one die to any face.

mind.x: Pay 1 energy for an extra reroll.

street.x: Gain 1 extra star when you start your turn in the city. In the city, if you roll at least one claw, add another claw.

thick.x: Whenever you lose 2 or more hearts at once, gain 1 energy.

wings.x: When you would lose hearts, you may pay 2 energy: you lose no hearts for the rest of that turn.

skydive.x: Gain 2 stars and take over Downtown. Every other monster in the city must leave it.

rush.x: Take another turn after this one.

refinery.x: Gain 2 stars. Every other monster loses 3 hearts.

carpet.x: Every monster, you included, loses 3 hearts.

cyclone.x: Gain 2 stars. Every other monster loses 1 energy for every 2 it holds.

m_free.x: You cannot buy this while you hold a Brainjack token. You get 1 extra reroll each turn.

m_evade.x: Use this card as a Brainjack token. After using it, give it to the monster you Brainjacked.

m_nobrain.x: Costs 2 energy more for each Brainjack token you hold. Add a claw to your roll every turn.

m_dysf.x: Every monster holding at least 1 Brainjack token, you included, loses 3 hearts.

m_treas.x: Buy a consumable card from the discard pile for 3 energy less.

m_mirac.x: Buy this only with 3 hearts or fewer. Lose all your stars, go back to 10 hearts and gain 1 Brainjack token.

m_trap.x: LOCK-ON. If you knock out the locked-on monster, gain 5 energy.

m_legend.x: LOCK-ON. If you knock out the locked-on monster, gain 4 stars.

m_unrel.x: LOCK-ON. If you do not knock out the locked-on monster, give it this card.

m_alloy.x: SLINK. This turn you may treat one of your 1s as any face.

m_offp.x: SLINK. Each star the other monsters lose this way also costs them 1 heart.

m_scept.x: SLINK. Take any consumable card from the discard pile for free.

m_earm.x: HARDENED. Gain 1 energy for each heart you would have lost.

m_ances.x: HARDENED. For the rest of this turn you may pay 2 energy to heal 1 heart, as often as you like.

m_petal.x: VENOM. The attacker also loses 1 star for each heart you lost.

m_cryst.x: VENOM. If you are knocked out this turn, the attacker loses twice the hearts you lost.

m_whip.x: VENOM. The attacker also loses 1 energy for each heart you lost.

m_bold.x: ENCORE. At the end of your encore turn, lose 5 hearts.

m_gift.x: ENCORE. At the end of your encore turn, lose 5 stars.

m_maxe.x: ENCORE. After your encore turn, roll 1 die fewer for the rest of the game.

m_shell.x: VENOM or HARDENED (you choose when you use it). No other effect.

m_spat.x: SLINK or LOCK-ON. If you knock out the locked-on monster, gain 1 star per heart you made it lose.

c_vamp.x: At the end of each monster’s turn, if you made another monster lose hearts during it, gain 1 heart.

11.x: When you wound a monster in the city, hand it this card. At the start of its turn you name a die face that does nothing for it that turn. You take the card back at the end of that turn.

12.x: Once per turn in your buy step, reveal a random card from the discard pile. Buy it for 1 energy less, or put it back.

13.x: Look at the top 3 power cards of the deck. Play one of them for free and put the others at the bottom.

14.x: Until your next turn, the other monsters roll 1 die fewer.

15.x: After your last roll you may pay 1 energy to lock one of your dice: nobody can change it this turn.

16.x: Until the start of your next turn, every monster gets a single roll and nobody can yield the city.

17.x: Gain 1 extra star each time you take over the city, or choose to stay in it when you could have yielded.

18.x: Pick a permanent evolution any monster has in play: this card copies it.

22.x: Turn over deck cards until you find a Keep card costing 4 or less. Play it for free; discard the rest.

23.x: Gain 1 energy for each heart you lost this turn.

24.x: Put 3 tokens on this card. On your turn, spend a token to sweep the 3 face-up cards for free. Discard this card when the tokens run out.

25.x: When you roll three or more 2s, every other monster loses 1 heart.

26.x: Before rolling you may put 2 energy on this card. If you then roll at least 3 claws, take them back and each monster you wound loses 2 extra hearts. If not, the energy is lost and you lose 2 hearts.

27.x: Once during your turn, you may pay 1 energy to gain 1 heart.

28.x: You may buy Keep cards for half their cost (round up) and put a barnacle token on them. At the start of your turn roll a die for each: discard it on a claw. At most 3 barnacle tokens at a time.

31.x: When you drop to 0 hearts: discard all your cards and evolutions, lose all energy and stars and leave the city. Then gain 9 hearts and 9 stars and keep playing.

32.x: Each other monster gives you 1 energy or 1 star, if it has any (it chooses).

34.x: Play at the start of your turn. You get only one roll, but its result counts double.

35.x: When you wound a monster in the city that must lose 2 or more hearts, you may make it lose 2 fewer and take 1 star and 1 energy from it instead.

36.x: In another monster’s Enter step, if Downtown is empty and you were not in the city at the start of the turn, you may move in instead.

37.x: If you roll at least one 1, gain 1 star.

38.x: If you roll at least one 1, add a claw to your roll.

41.x: When the monster holding Downtown leaves it or is knocked out, move in yourself.

42.x: Play when you would lose hearts or when you yield: you lose no hearts this turn.

43.x: After your Enter step: if you wounded a monster in the city and did not move in, take another turn after this one.

45.x: You can force monsters you wound to yield the city.

46.x: On each turn you wound at least one monster, gain 1 star.

47.x: Gain 1 extra star when you take over the city or start your turn there.

48.x: Play while you are in the city. Gain 1 star at the end of every monster’s turn. If you leave the city, discard this card and lose all your stars.

51.x: Play when you would lose hearts: you lose no hearts this turn.

54.x: Name a face: turn all your dice showing it into one other face of your choice.

55.x: When you start your turn in the city, every other monster loses 1 star.

56.x: Monsters that wound you lose 1 star.

57.x: Once per turn you may turn one of your dice into a claw.

58.x: Once per turn you may turn one of your dice into a 1 or a 2.

61.x: Play before resolving: each monster you wound this turn loses 2 extra hearts.

62.x: Gain 1 energy for each claw you rolled this turn.

63.x: Gain 3 stars and 2 energy each time another monster drops to 0 hearts.

64.x: Play before rolling, if you are outside the city: skip your turn and gain 4 hearts and 2 energy.

65.x: Once per turn, when you make monsters in the city lose hearts, every monster outside it (except you) also loses 1 heart.

66.x: When you lose hearts, roll a die for each heart lost. For each claw, the monster whose turn it is loses 1 heart.

67.x: On your turn, a monster you make lose 3 or more hearts loses 1 extra heart.

68.x: When a monster wounds you, you may give it the target token. The target loses 1 extra heart each time you make it lose hearts.

611.x: When you drop to 0 hearts you are not knocked out: gain 3 hearts, then roll 1 die fewer for the rest of the game.

612.x: When you drop to 0 hearts you are not knocked out: gain 3 hearts, then roll 1 die fewer for the rest of the game. Then discard this card.

613.x: Once per turn you may pay 1 energy to discard 2 of your dice and add a die showing any face.

614.x: HARDENED. If you must lose exactly 3 hearts, gain 3 hearts instead.

615.x: If your roll has exactly three 3s, take 1 star from the monster with the most stars.

616.x: If your roll has exactly 3 identical dice, every other monster loses 1 heart.

617.x: Play before resolving. If your roll has exactly 3 hearts, gain 3 hearts and the monster with the fewest hearts gains 1.

618.x: Play before resolving. If your roll has exactly 3 energy, the first power card you buy this turn costs 3 energy less.

622.x: Once per turn you may reroll all your energy dice.

623.x: From now on, each time another monster gains 4 or more stars at once, gain 1 star.

624.x: When you leave the city, gain 2 energy or 2 hearts.

625.x: When another monster resolves its dice, discard this to gain as many hearts and energy as it does.

626.x: At the start of your turn the others may pledge to you. Choose one of them: it gives you 4 stars and gains 1 Brainjack token.

627.x: When another monster is about to resolve its dice, pick 3 of them to reroll.

628.x: When another monster is about to resolve its dice, it must discard all its claws.

631.x: SLINK. Monsters in the city lose 1 extra star.

632.x: Once per turn, pay 1 energy to turn one of your hearts into a claw.

633.x: Draw the top card of another monster’s evolution deck.

634.x: When you wound a monster, it must discard all its power cards, but may pay 1 energy for each one it keeps.

635.x: HARDENED. You may also use this against effects that make you lose hearts.

636.x: LOCK-ON. If you lock on to the monster with the most energy, add 2 claws to your roll.

637.x: VENOM. If you lose 3 hearts or more, every other monster loses 1 heart.

638.x: ENCORE. After your encore turn, lose 2 stars, 2 hearts and 2 energy.

EXPS.d: Each monster has its own 8 evolution cards. Start with one; whenever you resolve three hearts, pick another. Keep them secret and play them when their text allows.
Resolve four of a kind to gain a cultist (one per face). Spend one on your turn for a heart, an energy or an extra reroll.
If you are already in the city, resolve four 1s to climb a level of the Tower. Levels 1 and 2 give hearts and energy each turn. Reaching the top wins at once.
Resolve four claws to go on a rampage and roll the rampage die too. Healing with hearts calms you down.
Each three 1s gives 2 menace and each three 2s gives 1 (up to 10). At 3, 6 and 10 take a menace tile.
Everyone starts in a costume with a power. Smash a monster with 3+ claws to buy its costume off its back.
A curse changes the rules for everyone. The Omen Die can swap it, punish you or bless you, and the Brass Beetle protects its holder from some curses.
